translations.web: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
translations.bsb: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. If someone slaps you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also;
translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
translations.asv: but I say unto you, resist not him that is evil: but whosoever smiteth thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
